primer: McKesson runs North America's largest drug toll-road ($403.43B FY2026 sales, $5.41B FCF) in a 90%+ oligopoly, while scaling Oncology and RxTS. The firm earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS quality verdict and PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health for CVS concentration, $5.06B opioid claims, and policy or cyber risks. MCK sits in a strong Stage 2 uptrend with +32.04% 63-day relative strength. At $1,069.43 (weekly RSI 71.10, +9.76% above the 50D SMA, NO_OPTIONS_EDGE) in a Downtrend, chasing offers weak 0.62:1 reward-to-risk. We assign ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP (TIER_1, CORE_ALPHA) with a $940.00–$985.00 entry zone, $857.69 stop, and $1,200.00 base target (1.69:1 support asymmetry).
